title: An extremal theorem for positive curvature of graphs
summary: We prove an extremal theorem for positive Ollivier/Lin--Lu--Yau curvature: every graph of order \(n\geq 8\) with more than \[ T(n)=\frac{n^2-3n}{2}-\left\lceil\frac{n}{2}\right\rceil+2 \] edges has positive Ollivier/Lin--Lu--Yau curvature, and this threshold is optimal. Moreover, for even $n\geq 12$, there exists a unique graph with $T(n)$ edges that has an edge with non-positive curvature. For $n=8,10$ and odd $n\geq 9$, the extremal graphs are not unique. This suggests a new class of extremal graph-theoretic problems arising from discrete curvature notions.
